title: Learning event
description: One observed interaction. Mint a UUID per occurrence and reuse it across delivery retries.

type.description: An engagement records an interaction. An attempt records practice of at least one fact or skill.

occurredAtMs.description: Time of the occurrence as Unix epoch milliseconds in UTC, within the interoperable JSON integer range.

activity.description: Stable source activity identifier within the app, retained for provenance and corrections.

targets.description: Records addressed by the interaction. Topics supply context and facts or skills identify learning targets.

score.description: Optional normalized result for the whole attempt. Zero is a measured result. Omit score when unscored.
